facts.fact: StackAdapt's co-founders coined the term 'Programmatic Native Advertising' four years before this 2017 post, per the vendor's own account.
facts.quote: It has been four years since my Co-Founders and I coined the term “Programmatic Native Advertising”.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's early expectation was that within 5 years the whole internet would be responsive, mobile-ready, and monetized through native ads, a prediction the company later said was incorrect in scope.
facts.quote: we were convinced that in the next 5 years, the whole internet would be responsive, mobile-ready, and monetized through native ads.

facts.fact: StackAdapt says its focus in 2017 turned to performance, meaning lead generation and sales rather than high click-through rate.
facts.quote: Acknowledging native advertising as a customer acquisition tactic, our focus in 2017 has turned to performance.
